title: POWERMOM, A Healthy Pregnancy Research Community
official: POWERMOM, A Healthy Pregnancy Research Community
summary: This study will take advantage of the open source framework of ResearchKit developed by Apple to bring research directly to participants. Using the ResearchKit platform as well as a stand alone app available for Android and HTML, it makes it easier to enroll large numbers of participants and carry out real-world health research to answer questions important to a broad population.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults, 16 years of age or older
* Pregnant women or within 8 weeks postpartum
* Currently live within the United States
* Own, and comfortable using, a smartphone or tablet

Exclusion Criteria:

• Inability to consent
